description: Source code for INA3221 sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS, including initialization, measurement, and register access functions.

methods.name: reg_read
methods.description: Reads a 16-bit register from the INA3221 device via I2C.

methods.name: reg_write
methods.description: Writes a 16-bit value to a register on the INA3221 device via I2C.

methods.name: ina3221_init
methods.description: Initializes the INA3221 device, verifies IDs, resets, and configures it.

methods.name: start_measurement
methods.description: Triggers measurement for voltage, current, or power on the INA3221.

methods.name: measurement_ready
methods.description: Checks if the measurement is complete and ready.

methods.name: ina3221_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches sensor data (voltage, current, power) from INA3221.

methods.name: ina3221_channel_get
methods.description: Converts raw INA3221 data into sensor values for a specific channel.

methods.name: ina3221_attr_set
methods.description: Sets attributes for INA3221, such as selected channel.
